pieces.Text: Whenever a winterwight damages a creature with a bite or claw, the wound erupts with tongues of black fire.  For the next 5 rounds, the victum must make a DC

Fortitude saving throw at the start of its turn or take 1d6 points of Constitution drain.  The winterwight gains 10 temporary hit points each time the creature fails a saving throw against blightfire.  A creature cannot be affected by more than one instance of blightfire at a time.
